title: 第21章 冰冰醒来第22章 这位小姐请等一下
slug: 分手后我聘上女同学妈妈小司机
content_zh:
傍晚八点，天色完全暗了下来。
酒店房间里，刘冰冰突然从床上惊醒，她猛地坐起身，眼神迷茫地环顾四周，喃喃自语：“这是在哪？”
她抬手揉了揉发沉的脑袋，脑海中渐渐浮现出中午的画面。
和陈阳在酒店包厢喝酒，自己喝得酩酊大醉，还扑进了他的怀里……
记忆碎片渐渐拼凑完整。
就在这时，她下意识地抬手捂住自己的胸，脸上突然露出了惊讶的神色：“咦？
胸怎么不痛了？”
她记得中午喝酒时，胸还痛得厉害，甚至忍不住哭了出来，可现在，胸没有丝毫不适的感觉。
“难道醉一场真的把病醉好了？”刘冰冰满脸疑惑，觉得这根本不可能。
她连忙掀开被子，快步冲到浴室。
浴室里亮着灯，镜子清晰地映照出她的身影。
她犹豫了一下，缓缓拉开自己的上衣，低头仔细检查胸。
原本应该存在硬块、按压会疼痛的地方，此刻却光滑细腻，没有任何异常。
她又轻轻按了按，确实没有丝毫痛感。
“怎么可能？
难道酒真的能消除结节？”刘冰冰站在镜子前，满脸难以置信，反复检查了好几遍，结果都一样。
她一边猜想，一边从浴室出来。
就在这时，门外传来了刷卡的声音，紧接着，房门被推开。
陈阳走了进来。
“啊！”刘冰冰惊呼一声，反应过来，连忙用手捂住胸口，脸颊瞬间红得像要滴血：“不要进来！”

陈阳一下愣住了，看到这一幕，他的脸颊也泛起了红晕，连忙转过身去，语气带着几分尴尬：“冰冰，我不知道你醒了。”
“你快出去！”刘冰冰羞得不行。
“好，我在外面等你。”陈阳连忙说。
说完，他快步退出房间，轻轻关上了房门。
房间里，刘冰冰心脏“砰砰砰”地狂跳不止，脸颊烫得惊人。
她低头看了看自己的身子，又想起刚才陈阳看到自己的样子，羞得恨不得找个地缝钻进去：“真是羞死了……
太丢人了……”
刘冰冰深吸几口气，才平静了点。
整理好衣物后，她又对着浴室的镜子照了照，确认自己仪容得体。
这才咬了咬嘴唇，硬着头皮走向房门。
房门缓缓打开，刘冰冰一眼就看到了站在走廊里等候的陈阳。
她脸颊瞬间又热了起来，眼神有些闪躲，浑身都透着一股不自在。
陈阳的目光落在她身上。
小腹熟悉的燥热感再次升起。
刘冰冰脸颊带着未褪尽的微红，更显娇俏。
他强压体内的异样，表面上依旧保持着冷静，走上前，关切问：“你没事吧？
感觉有没有好点？”
看着陈阳神色自然，语气真诚，没有丝毫调侃之意，刘冰冰悬着的心稍微放下了些。
她轻轻点了点头，语气带着几分困惑：“我没事……
就是觉得很奇怪。

我胸口的结节，竟然真的消失了。
现在一点痛感都没有了。”
“那太好了！”陈阳脸上露出由衷的笑。
“你不觉得这太神奇了吗？”刘冰冰皱着眉头，满脸难以置信，“就喝了点酒，怎么可能把结节给消掉？”
陈阳早有准备，不动声色说：“可能是你之前体内有淤堵，酒精刚好帮你把淤堵化解开了，也算是歪打正着。”
content_en:
At eight o'clock in the evening, the sky became completely dark.
In the hotel room, Liu Bingbing suddenly woke up from the bed. She sat up suddenly, looked around with confused eyes, and muttered to herself: "Where is this?"
She raised her hand to rub her heavy head, and the scene at noon gradually appeared in her mind.
I was drinking with Chen Yang in a hotel room. I was so drunk that I even threw myself into his arms...
The memory fragments gradually pieced together.
At this moment, she subconsciously raised her hands to cover her breasts, and a look of surprise suddenly appeared on her face: "Huh?
Why doesn't my chest hurt anymore? "
She remembered that when she was drinking at noon, her chest still hurt so much that she couldn't help but cry. But now, she doesn't feel any discomfort in her chest.
"Could it be true that getting drunk can cure your illness?" Liu Bingbing looked puzzled and thought this was impossible.
She quickly opened the quilt and rushed to the bathroom.
The light was on in the bathroom, and her figure was clearly reflected in the mirror.
She hesitated for a moment, then slowly opened her top and lowered her head to examine her breasts carefully.
The area that should have been hard and painful when pressed was now smooth and delicate without any abnormalities.
She pressed it gently again, and indeed there was no pain at all.
"How is that possible?
Can wine really eliminate nodules? "Liu Bingbing stood in front of the mirror with a face full of disbelief. She checked it several times, but the result was the same.
She came out of the bathroom while guessing.
At this moment, the sound of swiping a card came from outside the door, and then the door was pushed open.
Chen Yang walked in.
"Ah!" Liu Bingbing exclaimed, reacted, and quickly covered her chest with her hands. Her cheeks instantly turned red and looked like they were about to drip blood: "Don't come in!"
Chen Yang was stunned for a moment. When he saw this scene, his cheeks turned red. He turned around quickly and said with a bit of embarrassment: "Bingbing, I didn't know you were awake."
"Get out quickly!" Liu Bingbing was so embarrassed.
"Okay, I'll wait for you outside." Chen Yang said quickly.
After saying that, he quickly exited the room and closed the door gently.
In the room, Liu Bingbing's heart was beating wildly and her cheeks were alarmingly hot.
She looked down at her body, and then remembered the way Chen Yang saw her just now. She was so embarrassed that she wanted to find a crack in the ground to crawl in: "I'm so embarrassed...
It’s so embarrassing…”
Liu Bingbing took a few deep breaths and calmed down a little.
After arranging her clothes, she looked in the bathroom mirror again to make sure she was well groomed.
Then he bit his lip and walked towards the door bravely.
The door slowly opened, and Liu Bingbing saw Chen Yang waiting in the corridor.
Her cheeks instantly became hot again, her eyes were a little evasive, and there was a sense of discomfort all over her body.
Chen Yang's eyes fell on her.
The familiar hot feeling in my lower abdomen rose again.
Liu Bingbing's cheeks were still slightly red, making her look even more delicate.
He suppressed the strangeness in his body and remained calm on the surface. He walked forward and asked with concern: "Are you okay?
Feeling any better? "
Seeing Chen Yang's natural look and sincere tone, without the slightest hint of ridicule, Liu Bingbing felt relieved a little.
She nodded slightly, with a bit of confusion in her tone: "I'm fine...
It just feels weird.
The knots on my chest actually disappeared.
There is no pain at all now. "
"That's great!" A heartfelt smile appeared on Chen Yang's face.
"Don't you think this is amazing?" Liu Bingbing frowned, with disbelief on her face, "How can it be possible to get rid of the nodules just by drinking some wine?"
Chen Yang was well prepared and said calmly: "Maybe you had a blockage in your body before, and the alcohol just helped you to dissolve the blockage. It can be regarded as a hit."
